A deactivated '''G0-T0 infrastructure planning system''' said to have been recovered from the asteroid field left behind by the destroyed [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malachor V]] was on display in the [[Museum Republica]] in the [[Axial Park]] district of the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. The infrastructure planning system and crime boss known as [[G0-T0]] was present on Malachor V during its destruction in [[3951 BBY]], but like many objects in the museum, the actual validity of the item was questionable.
